visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, straight dark hair and a white ribbed top is shown in a head-and-shoulders shot against a neutral, softly lit grey studio wall. She smiles warmly at the lens, squinting her eyes slightly, and gently brushes her fingers against her cheek to emphasize her smooth skin texture. (2) A quick cut displays the DV 醇耀妍 3.0 product box, featuring pink floral graphics and bold black typography. The scene shifts to the woman lying on a white bed with plush pillows; she cradles the box next to her face, projecting a relaxed and youthful appearance under bright, diffused indoor lighting. (3) In a medium shot, the woman holds a single white and pink sachet, pointing to it with her right hand while maintaining a cheerful expression. The camera then captures her at a dark wooden table, carefully extracting a sachet from the opened packaging, highlighting the physical interaction with the product. (4) Standing by a window with sheer white curtains, the woman is seen in a side profile as she drinks the liquid supplement from the sachet. The natural daylight illuminates her face, followed by a close-up of her hand touching her jawline, demonstrating the supposed skin-tightening effect of the product. (5) A split-screen graphic appears, labeled 'Before' and 'After', comparing a duller skin tone to her current glowing complexion. This is followed by shots of her sitting comfortably, holding the box and sachets, her hands adorned with subtle jewelry, set against the soft background of a modern living space. (6) The final sequence features the woman smiling broadly while holding the product box close to her face on the bed. The video concludes with a clean graphic transition to a white screen featuring the 'DÉESSE VIVANTE' brand logo in gold and black text, ending the promotional narrative.
